title: Elementary chains in a common span
statement: Let R be a commutative local ring, M an R-module and f,g length-c tuples with the same span. A finite chain of unit scalings, transpositions and shears connects f to g. Work in the common finite span and apply [lem-pur-local-generating-tuples].

proof.text: Lift both tuples into their common span, a finite module because a finite tuple generates it. Both lifted tuples generate the entire submodule.
Apply [lem-pur-local-generating-tuples], discard the matrix witnesses and map each operation through the submodule inclusion. Induct through the finite sequence.
